name: python-hdr-histogram
title: Latency Histogram
blurb: Percentiles with a promised error: bucket-indexed latencies whose relative error is bounded and measured, merges that are exact, memory that depends on the value range and not on the sample count, and the average-of-percentiles trap printed side by side with the truth.
default_description: A bucketed latency histogram with a bounded relative error, exact merges, and percentiles checked against the true nearest-rank answer.
next_steps: uv venv --allow-existing .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff
